data.long_meaning: The name Vishnupriya is derived from Sanskrit and Hindu traditions. It is a combination of two words: Vishnu and Priya. Vishnu is the name of the Hindu God of Preservation, while Priya means 'beloved' or 'lover'. Thus, Vishnupriya translates to 'Lover of Vishnu' or 'Beloved of Vishnu'.
